textual_extract: (1) And representation must also mean that women have a meaningful voice in the decisions that shape our common future. They are already at the forefront of this organisation's work, from development to peacekeeping. As the UN considers its next secretary general, maybe it is time that this representation be reflected at the highest level.
coder_notes: Implies gender representation at SG level but does not explicitly endorse a woman SG; coded Mixed rather than Positive per rule requiring explicit 'a woman'/'she' language.

textual_extract: (1) We also commend the outgoing President for her distinguished stewardship. Her tenure reminds us of an unfinished chapter in the history of this Organisation. Eight decades later, the United Nations has yet to be led by a woman as Secretary-General.
